evals.prompt: Set up Cyclone UI in my Vite + React + TS app (pnpm, src/main.tsx, @vitejs/plugin-react-swc). It should follow the OS light/dark preference.
evals.expected_output: Installs @cyclone-ui/vite and runtime deps, adds cycloneUI() after react(), wraps the app in ThemeProvider with disableInjectCSS={false} and a mode-following _base Theme.

evals.prompt: Vite app, package.json has no "type" field and vite.config.js already registers tamaguiPlugin({ config: './src/tamagui.config.ts' }) from @tamagui/vite-plugin. Switch it to the Cyclone vite plugin but keep our custom tamagui config.
evals.expected_output: Replaces tamaguiPlugin with cycloneUI({ config: './src/tamagui.config.ts' }), handles ESM-only by renaming to vite.config.mts, and passes the same config to ThemeProvider.
